name: picast
title: PiCast
description: Chat with a read-only Pi agent from your home directory using your own provider credentials.
author: josevelaz

commands.name: runs-pi
commands.title: Chat with Pi
commands.subtitle: PiCast
commands.description: Resume or start a persistent Pi chat with read-only file tools.

commands.name: manage-pi
commands.title: Manage PiCast
commands.subtitle: PiCast
commands.description: Choose providers, models, plugins, and skills for PiCast.

preferences.name: inheritGlobalPi
preferences.title: Pi Configuration
preferences.label: Inherit global Pi settings
preferences.description: Use global Pi auth, models, settings, context, plugins, and skills. Turn this off to keep PiCast credentials and config isolated.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
